response.query: What simulation scenarios, parameter priors, and decision rules should we pre-register to show the operating characteristics of our sensitivity analyses under plausible MNAR or selection biases?
response.answer: Pre-register simulation scenarios with plausible MNAR biases, parameter priors based on historical data, and decision rules aligned with ESG criteria. Focus on sensitivity analyses to evaluate robustness under selection biases.

results.title: Prudence and Loyalty in Selecting Plan Investments and Exercising ...
results.content: The Department received several comments on the language in paragraph (b)(2)(ii)(C) of the proposal which specified that consideration of the projected return of the portfolio relative to the funding objectives of the plan “may often require an evaluation of the economic effects of climate change and other environmental, social or governance factors on the particular investment or investment course of action.” This new language—the “may often require” clause—was proposed by the Department to counteract any negative perception against the consideration of climate change and other ESG factors in investment decisions caused by the current regulation.
